name: chat-marks
description: Highlight and bookmark the parts of a long Claude Code conversation that matter, then jump back to them. Select words in a Claude reply with the mouse and press your highlight key to give them a background colour. Press your mark key and a letter appears on every message on screen: press one to mark that message. Next / previous keys jump through every mark and highlight. The marks panel lists them all with a letter each: j / k preview, Enter jumps, Esc goes back to where you were. Choose your own hotkeys in the panel's Hotkeys tab (/mark keys); /mark lang zh switches the interface to Chinese. Needs the fullscreen renderer (/tui fullscreen). Screenshots and docs: https://github.com/vi000246/claude-chat-marks
